description: This Java class 'CommonSecret' encapsulates shared properties and behaviors for secret management within the Eclipse Hono project, including timestamp validation and fluent setters.

classes.name: CommonSecret
classes.description: An abstract class representing common secret attributes used in the Eclipse Hono project, including validity timestamps, enabled flag, and comments.

methods.name: getEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether the secret is enabled.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Sets the enabled flag indicating whether to use this secret during authentication.

methods.name: getNotBefore
methods.description: Gets the earliest valid time for the secret.

methods.name: getNotAfter
methods.description: Gets the latest valid time for the secret.

methods.name: setNotBefore
methods.description: Sets the earliest valid time for the secret.

methods.name: setNotAfter
methods.description: Sets the latest valid time for the secret.

methods.name: getComment
methods.description: Retrieves the comment describing the secret.

methods.name: setComment
methods.description: Sets the human-readable comment for the secret.

methods.name: toStringHelper
methods.description: Creates a helper object for producing string representations with properties.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the object.

methods.name: checkValidity
methods.description: Validates the secret's timestamp fields ensuring 'not-before' is before 'not-after'.
